event_name: BAHRAIN GRAND PRIX 03 - 05 March 2023 The Stewards From The Stewards To The Team Manager, MoneyGram Haas F1 Team
fact: Leaving the track without a justifiable reason multiple times.
offence: Breach of Article 33.3 of the FIA Formula One Sporting Regulations, Article 12.2.1 i) of the International Sporting Code and non-compliance with Race Director's Event Note (item 16.1, document 19).
reason: The Stewards reviewed video, and received timing information from the Race Director. Car 27 (HUL) left the track on five (5) occasions without justifiable reason, after having received a 5 second penalty on the fourth (4th) occasion.
rules_referenced: Article 33.3 of the FIA Formula One Sporting Regulations
stewards: in accordance with Article 15 of the FIA International Sporting Code
title: Offence Car 27 Leaving The Track Five Times
to: The Team Manager, MoneyGram Haas F1 Team
